description: This file contains upgrade-related functions for a Linux-based embedded system, including methods for boot device detection, image validation, upgrade process, and configuration copying, specifically tailored for STM32 hardware.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Detects and exports the boot device based on kernel command line variables and Uevent data.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout in the image matches the current device, warning if they differ.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by writing image data to appropriate partitions, handling U-boot environment saving, and updating root partition UUID.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files or backups into the boot partition.
